title: The Kind Of Love That Lasts

scenes.narration: The kind of love that lasts is not built on perfect moments.
scenes.image_query: The kind of love that lasts is not built on perfect moments.

scenes.narration: It is built on patience, on forgiveness, on choosing gentleness when being right would be easier.
scenes.image_query: It is built on patience, on forgiveness, on choosing gentleness when being right would be easier.

scenes.narration: On holding hands through ordinary days and heavy seasons.
scenes.image_query: On holding hands through ordinary days and heavy seasons.

scenes.narration: Because forever is never made from one beautiful promise.
scenes.image_query: Because forever is never made from one beautiful promise.

scenes.narration: It is made from two people choosing each other in the quietest ways.
